audio_description:
A lone missile streaks across the sky.
Top-down, winged cruise missiles plunge toward Balamb Garden's ring.
They burst in orange against the hull as the Garden is swarmed.

context.scene_title: Cruise missiles dive on the mobile Balamb Garden (Disc 2).
locations: The sky and airspace around the now-airborne Balamb Garden, over green countryside

characters.name: (Galbadian cruise missiles)
characters.recognition: Finned cruise missiles with deployed white wings (one marked '08') diving toward the Garden, trailing fire and detonating against it.

context.summary: A lone missile streaks across the sky, then a top-down view shows winged Galbadian cruise missiles plunging toward Balamb Garden's ring, exploding in bursts of orange against the hull as the mobile academy is swarmed.
context.context_note: High confidence: the cruise-missile assault on the mobile Balamb Garden.
